name: agentgateway identity-aware control plane (contributions)
tagline: Nine substantial pull requests turning agentgateway from a model proxy into an identity-aware control plane for agents.
problem: An agent gateway that only proxies model calls cannot enforce identity or explain agent execution.
solution: Upstream PRs adding identity at the edge, OpenTelemetry-based observability of agent execution, and support for multiple model providers.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Nine substantial merged-quality PRs spanning identity, observability and multi-provider support.
Contribution moved the product's positioning (proxy → control plane), not just fixed bugs.

lessons: Frame contributions as a capability shift in the upstream project.

curator_notes: Rust in stack is an assumption about agentgateway (organizer blog describes it as Rust-powered in a related post); repo URL assumed canonical — verify.
